answer: Divergent-challenge identity probing. Each agent must answer a freshly generated task whose correct output depends on a hidden seed, so genuine agents with distinct internal state diverge while clones of one source produce correlated answers. A sable operator running many copies fails because a mesa-wide comparison of answer distributions exposes the shared seed, forcing each identity to maintain independent state. Every spoofed sparrow identity thus costs a full separate answer-generating process, not a cheap copy.
